headline_hook: DeepSeek Ships Speculative Decoding in the Weights While Vercel Rewrites the AI SDK Playbook
preview_topics: Vercel AI SDK's v7 breaking changes
agents that render video from HTML

pick_of_the_day.thesis: DeepSeek baking speculative decoding directly into V4 Pro's weights — shipping model and paper on the same day — signals that inference optimization is becoming a first-class model design decision, not a post-training bolt-on. This collapses the traditional boundary between model architecture and serving infrastructure.

model_literacy.relevance: DSpark shows how draft-then-verify inference can be integrated at the model-weights level rather than requiring a separate draft model. With DeepSeek shipping it natively, builders need to understand when speculative decoding helps (long outputs, high latency tolerance) versus hurts (short completions, memory-constrained deployments).

items.title: llama.cpp Rewrites OpenCL Flash Attention with Smart KV Tile Classification
